title: Whole-body loosen up
about: An unhurried loosen-up for stiff mornings and rest days.

steps.name: Cat stretch
steps.cue: On hands and knees, round your back up slowly, then let it sink. Move with your breath.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Sit back on your heels, arms long in front, forehead down. Breathe into your back.

steps.name: World's greatest stretch
steps.cue: Long lunge, both hands inside the front foot, then reach the inside arm to the ceiling.

steps.name: Kneeling hip flexor
steps.cue: Back knee down, tuck your tail under and ease the hips forward. Stay tall.

steps.name: Seated hamstring
steps.cue: Legs straight, hinge forward from the hips with a long back. No bouncing.

steps.name: Lying glute stretch
steps.cue: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee, pull the legs gently toward you.

steps.name: Knee across the body
steps.cue: On your back, draw one knee across and let it fall, shoulders staying down.

steps.name: Seated twist
steps.cue: Sit tall, cross one leg over and turn toward it. Lengthen as you breathe in, turn as you breathe out.

steps.name: Shoulder stretch
steps.cue: Draw one arm across your chest with the other. Keep the shoulder away from your ear.

steps.name: Side bend
steps.cue: Reach one arm up and over. Hips stay square, both feet heavy.

steps.name: Standing forward fold
steps.cue: Soft knees, let your head and arms hang. Roll up slowly at the end.

title: After leg day
about: Hips, quads, hamstrings and calves, while they are warm.

steps.name: Quad stretch
steps.cue: Heel toward your seat, knees together, hips pressed gently forward.

steps.name: Seated hamstring
steps.cue: One leg long, fold over it from the hips with a flat back.

steps.name: Lying glute stretch
steps.cue: Ankle over the opposite knee, pull both legs in.

steps.name: Outer hip stretch
steps.cue: Cross one leg over and hug the knee toward the opposite shoulder.

steps.name: Inner thigh stretch
steps.cue: Wide stance, sink toward one side keeping the other leg straight.

steps.name: Kneeling hip flexor
steps.cue: Back knee down, tail tucked, hips forward.

steps.name: Calf stretch
steps.cue: Hands on the wall, back heel down and leg straight, lean in.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Sit back on your heels and let your back let go.

steps.name: Shoulder circles
steps.cue: Slow, big circles forward, then back.

steps.name: Chest and front shoulder
steps.cue: Hands clasped behind you, lift the arms and open the chest.

steps.name: Chest stretch at the wall
steps.cue: Palm on the wall at shoulder height, turn your body away from it.

steps.name: Lat stretch
steps.cue: One arm overhead, hold the wrist and lean away.

steps.name: Upper back stretch
steps.cue: Clasp your hands in front, round between the shoulder blades and push away.

steps.name: Triceps stretch
steps.cue: Elbow up by your ear, ease it back with the other hand.

steps.name: Side neck stretch
steps.cue: Ear toward shoulder, the opposite arm long and heavy.

steps.name: Cat stretch
steps.cue: Finish on hands and knees, rounding and releasing the spine.

title: Mat core, pilates style
about: Controlled floor work for the deep core, hips and back. Slow and precise beats fast.

steps.name: Pelvic tilt into bridge
steps.cue: Flatten your lower back, then peel the spine up one bone at a time. Roll down the same way.

steps.name: Leg lowers
steps.cue: On your back, lower both legs only as far as your lower back stays down.

steps.name: Scissors
steps.cue: Legs long and low, switch them in small, even beats. Ribs down.

steps.name: Double leg pull
steps.cue: Draw both knees in, then reach the legs away without arching.

steps.name: Criss-cross
steps.cue: Elbow toward the opposite knee, turning from the ribs, not the neck.

steps.name: Swimming
steps.cue: Face down, lift opposite arm and leg and switch in a steady flutter.

steps.name: Side plank
steps.cue: Elbow under shoulder, one long line from head to heels.

steps.name: Side leg lifts
steps.cue: On your side, lift the top leg without rocking the hips.

steps.name: Plank
steps.cue: Forearms down, squeeze your seat, breathe steadily.

steps.name: Cat stretch
steps.cue: Round and release the spine to ease the back.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Rest back on your heels and breathe.
